system.fault.note: Register dump over polled USB CDC + SOS blink. HardFault verified on Core.U.2 (projects/fault-test)

system.wdog.note: 2s IWDG resets MCU after starved refresh — USB + PWM ramp test (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

timer.tick.note: Verified on Core.U.2 — LED blink via ISR (projects/timer-ticker)

timer.pwm.note: TIM15 PWM → EXTI loopback verified on Core.U.2 (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

timer.capture.note: TIM2 32-bit capture measuring TIM15 PWM period — 499995 us @ 2 Hz (projects/timers-pwmg_u2)

coregen.timer.note: Generates PAD_n_TIM/CH defines and core_pad_timer_info(); tested on adc-pwm example

progdebug.custom_dfu.note: App-request DFU bootloader (2.7KB). 1200-baud touch auto-triggers from make flash-dfu. projects/bootloader + projects/hello

power.stop.note: Stop 1 + RTC wakeup + clock recovery to 80MHz PLL (projects/power-test)

power.standby.note: Standby + RTC wakeup, full reset on wake (projects/power-test)

power.rtc_wake.note: LSI RTC wakeup from Stop and Standby (projects/power-test)

power.exti_wake.note: Falling edge on pad 10 wakes from Stop 1 + clock recovery (projects/power-test)

power.rtc_alarm.note: LL+Core Alarm A implemented. ALRMAR writes read back 0 on test L422 — hw investigation needed. RTC time set/get and ticking verified (tests/val-backup-rng-alarm-u)

power.backup.note: Core API implemented. BKPxR writes read back 0 on test L422 — same root cause as alarm (hw investigation). All access bits correct (DBP, RTCEN, WPR)

security.rng.note: HSI48 + CCIPR mux. 6/6 tests pass: init, read, uniqueness, fill, error check, deinit/reinit (tests/val-backup-rng-alarm-u)

adc.comp.note: L422 has COMP1/COMP2; pins available on Core.U.2
